text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d a j-a-m-m-e-r b-l-o-c-k-i-n-g g-n-s-s r-e-c-e-i-v-e-r s, f-o-u-n-d d-r-o-n-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y d-u-m-p s i-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e h-a-g s, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-a-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-r-r-a-d-i-a-t-e-d c-o-v-e-r a-g-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y d-u-m-p s a-n-d c-o-v-e-r a-g-e l-o-g s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e g-n-s-s i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e c-e-r-t i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-c-t-u-s h-a-c-k-e-d d-r-o-n-e n-a-v i-g-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g s i-n t-h-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y d-u-m-p s, f-o-u-n-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t s i-n t-h-e f-r-e-i-g-h-t l-o-c-k-e-r s, a-n-d r-o-u-t-e-d d-r-o-n-e t-r-a-f-f-i-c t-o t-h-e f-r-e-i-g-h-t l-o-c-k-e-r s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g h-a-c-k-e-d n-a-v i-g-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g s a-n-d r-o-u-t-e d-c-c s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-o-u-t-i-n-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d t-h-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-e-a-k-n-e-s s i-n t-h-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y d-u-m-p s, f-o-u-n-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t s i-n t-h-e f-r-e-i-g-h-t l-o-c-k-e-r s, a-n-d i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e s w-h-i-l-e d-r-o-n-e s l-a-n-d-e-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y d-u-m-p s a-n-d i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d a j-a-m-m-e-r b-l-o-c-k-i-n-g g-n-s-s r-e-c-e-i-v-e-r s, f-o-u-n-d c-o-v-e-r a-g-e l-o-g s i-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e h-a-g s, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-a-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-r-r-a-d-i-a-t-e-d c-o-v-e-r a-g-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-o-v-e-r a-g-e l-o-g s a-n-d d-r-o-n-e h-a-g s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e j-a-m-m-e-r p-w-e-r l-i-m-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-c-t-u-s h-a-c-k-e-d d-r-o-n-e n-a-v i-g-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g s i-n t-h-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y d-u-m-p s, f-o-u-n-d r-o-u-t-e d-c-c s i-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e h-a-g s, a-n-d r-o-u-t-e-d d-r-o-n-e t-r-a-f-f-i-c t-o t-h-e f-r-e-i-g-h-t l-o-c-k-e-r s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g h-a-c-k-e-d n-a-v i-g-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g s a-n-d r-o-u-t-e d-c-c s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
